const lines = $('Plan').all().filter(i => i.json.kind === 'event').map(i => '- ' + i.json.label);
return [{ json: { text: `📅 New in the calendar:\n${lines.join('\n')}` } }];

// The orchestrator reads only your own calendar: deadlines and planning sessions are there
return [{ json: { calendarId: String($('Config').first().json.CALENDAR_ID ?? '').trim() } }];
